en.headline: Fire at Cheung Sha Wan factory building extinguished in 15 minutes, one person unwell
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in an open-air canopy area at Kaming Factory Building on Castle Peak Road shortly after 10:30 a.m., with one person treated at the scene.
body: Firefighters extinguished a fire at Kaming Factory Building on Castle Peak Road in Cheung Sha Wan within about 15 minutes of arriving on Friday morning.

The Fire Services Department responded to the blaze, which broke out at approximately 10:33 a.m. in an open-air canopy area of the industrial building at 688-690 Castle Peak Road. Crews used water jets to bring the flames under control.

One person reported feeling unwell during the incident and received medical treatment from paramedics at the scene. No other injuries were reported. Authorities are investigating the cause of the fire.
The building is an industrial premises near Lai Chi Kok MTR station. Police and firefighters remained at the scene to examine the area after the fire was put out.

zh.headline: 長沙灣嘉名工廠大廈火警15分鐘撲熄 一人不適
zh.dek: 消防今早約10時33分到場，約15分鐘內撲滅青山道688-690號嘉名工廠大廈露天簷篷位置火警，一人不適在場接受治理。
body: 消防處今早撲滅長沙灣青山道嘉名工廠大廈一宗火警，到場後約15分鐘內將火勢控制及撲滅。
火警於上午約10時33分發生在青山道688-690號工業大廈的露天簷篷位置，消防人員使用水喉射水將火撲熄。
事發期間有一人感到不適，由救護人員在場治理，並無其他傷者報告。有關部門正調查火警成因。
該大廈屬工業樓宇，鄰近荔枝角港鐵站。火勢撲滅後，警方及消防人員留在現場檢查。
